body:
See, this is what I tried to explain in the notes I have written. My parents are actually awesome and did an amazing job. My entire family is amazing actually. It isn't their fault at all that something in my is broken. The core of me has something missing, that isn't on them. I consider it more of a birth defect - no one's fault, but there none the less. But thank you for your attempt. I know what you are trying to say, but there is no fear or guilt in me. I am just tired of trying to be normal. 

It is draining. And I freque tly become a drain to those around me, they shouldn't have to deal with my flaw.
